need.title: Type of need
need.prompt: Great, {name}! What kind of need do you have?

newProduct.label: Build a digital product from scratch.

description.title: Problem description
description.prompt: Tell me a bit more about what you have in mind, {name}.
description.hint: What problem do you want to solve? What do you hope to build or improve?

newProduct.prompt: Nice, {name}! Tell me about the idea: what do you want to build?
newProduct.hint: Who is it for, what problem does it solve and what can't be missing from the first version?

idea.label: Your idea
idea.placeholder: E.g. an app for clinics to book appointments over WhatsApp...

evolveProduct.prompt: Tell me about the product and what you want to evolve, {name}.
evolveProduct.hint: What does it do today and what needs to change or be added: features, integrations, scale?

idea.label: What to evolve
idea.placeholder: E.g. reports are manual today; I'd like to automate and export them...

improveExperience.prompt: Where does the experience fall short today, {name}?
improveExperience.hint: Slow screens, confusing flows, dated visuals? Tell me what bothers you or your users the most.

idea.label: What to improve
idea.placeholder: E.g. checkout has too many steps and is slow on mobile...

fixProblems.hint: What should happen, what actually happens and since when? If you know the tech stack, it helps.

idea.label: The problem
idea.placeholder: E.g. since the last update, login fails for some users...

deadline.title: Timeline
deadline.prompt: And when would you like to start, {name}?

noDeadline.label: I don't have a set timeline yet.

budget.title: Investment
budget.prompt: Do you already have an expected investment for this project?

talkFirst.label: I'd rather talk before defining it.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Choose the currency of the amount.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.prompt: We're almost done, {name}! Which e-mail and WhatsApp can I use to get back to you?
